title: Re-Send Days After a Larkspur-Side Return — Closing and Funding
content:
**Rule.** The re-send days of Larkspur's re-send standard on a Closing and Funding closing are set from when the return came in:

- where a Larkspur-side return came in after the closing method's funding request cutoff time, they are the method's returned-wire re-send business days plus one;
- where it came in no later than that cutoff, they are the method's returned-wire re-send business days;
- otherwise there are none.

A wire return is Larkspur-side when the settlement agent rejected a wire whose amount differs from the amount of the wire that funded the loan (Larkspur's wrong amount), or when Larkspur recalled the wire because a prior-to-funding item was open (a return marked as funding conditions unmet). The wire that funded the loan is the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date, and the return looked at is the closing's latest wire return. The time the return came in is the time recorded on the wire return.

## Figures for every closing method

The funding request cutoff time is 12:00 US Eastern and the returned-wire re-send figure is 1 business day under the Larkspur Traditional Wet, Escrow Dry-Funding, Mobile Notary, Hybrid eClosing, Remote Online Notarization, Power of Attorney and Mail-Away closings alike.

| Larkspur-side return came in at | Re-send days |
|---|---|
| 12:01 or later | 2 |
| 12:00 exactly | 1 |
| 09:45 | 1 |
| (no Larkspur-side return) | none |
